Create one complete original photorealistic editorial photograph, portrait aspect ratio 2:3, high resolution. It will fill a narrow full-height photo strip in a Bellas training slide. Keep at least the TOP 20% and BOTTOM 20% of the final image free of faces, hair crowns, hands, product and other important subjects: only continuous natural room background at the top and natural dark fabric, floor or countertop at the bottom. All important subjects between y=22% and y=77%, centered horizontally with extra side room for a slight crop. No artificial bars, no dark painted bottom band, no seams. Contemporary premium natural photography, realistic anatomy and skin texture, restrained saturation, balanced exposure. No overlaid words, schedule widget, captions, watermarks or logos outside the genuine product packaging. Do not make a collage, slide layout, poster or multi-panel sheet.
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Reference image 1 is the product packaging, not a background to copy. Reference image 2 is the adult woman's identity, not the graphic composition to copy. Preserve her recognizable facial features, green eyes, long naturally dark wavy hair, natural skin texture and age. Preserve the real 270 g Reverse Drink Tangerina jar's cylindrical squat proportions, broad low white screw lid, white body, orange lower label, tangerine illustration and branded front label. The jar is a plausible handheld supplement pot, approximately face-width, not a large bucket. The readable primary packaging words remain VITAE, Reverse Drink, TANGERINA and 270 g; preserve the reference artwork without inventing new health claims or new package text.
Scene: a quiet contemporary cream and greige living room, soft side window light, a simple upholstered chair, an uncluttered wall above the subject. Show this same adult woman seated, framed widely from knees upwards, wearing a contemporary slate-blue sleeveless blouse and neutral trousers, with understated jewelry. She looks warmly at the camera while naturally holding the closed Reverse Drink pot at chest/waist height with both hands, label facing camera. Her head is below the top quarter, hands and jar safely around y=55-68%, lower fifth is naturally dark trouser/chair fabric and floor. A calm approachable presentation of the product, not an exaggerated endorsement pose. Camera at chest height, 70 mm portrait feel, realistic perspective and subtle depth of field.
